name: Spend
why: Compute Crafter's compute and credits, from free allowances first to idle capacity dropped
ideal: Use free and included allowances before anything that bills, read their use the same day, and never idle free capacity in a lane over budget.

sources.title: REST API endpoints for billing usage

steps.name: Re-read
steps.rule: Re-read each free-tier figure on its provider's own page, and record the date.

steps.name: Free first
steps.rule: Claim every free allowance before anything that bills.

steps.name: Read
steps.rule: Each allowance's use is read the same day.

steps.name: Stay under
steps.rule: CI stays under the included minutes; no overage, no larger runners.
gates: Spend past the included amount waits for the owner's yes (Git Crafter rules/compute.md)

steps.name: Drop idle
steps.rule: Free capacity in a lane over budget never sits idle; swap in a cheaper lane.
